limits: Text inspection covers current English source projects and delivery files, with HTML entities, percent encoding and JSON escapes decoded.
Historical workspace notes and Russian manuals are outside the English manual scope.
OCR is a supporting check, not proof of absence; animations are sampled at first, middle and last frame. External videos and the contents of downloadable binary examples are not inspected.
Images smaller than 100 by 100 pixels are omitted from OCR; SVG content is inspected as text.
